not blocking, but why check the URI option instead of the multi-host option?

Do you want to replace the multi-host option and instead branch on an empty RF system URI name instead?

I mean it makes sense, an empty system URI name could indicate a multi-host system.
One less option to worry about.

But i am still confused since the branches in your other patches look different, where you mostly branch on the multi-host option.

Maybe this would be easier if we passed an `std::optional<std::string>` for the system name instead of having two symbols used throughout the code.

Then there would only be one thing to branch on and clang-tidy could help check that any code path accessing the RF system name should have a check beforehand.
This revision is over a year old and does not reflect what we are doing today ^^ I am still waiting for the change in obmc-console to potentially rework hostlogger and push a new revision.
